text_block_list.name: Spectator with a Hat
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, did you see? The names of the 
girls running in this race!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator in a Shirt
text_block_list.text:
I saw it! A foreign-born girl is 
participating, right?

text_block_list.name: Spectator with a Hat
text_block_list.text:
No, look. Her name was on it! She was on 
TV the other day, too. I really, really 
like her, you know~

text_block_list.name: Spectator in a Shirt
text_block_list.text:
"TV? ...Wait, that name! Is this kid 
running in this race?!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator in a Shirt
text_block_list.text:
"I used to follow Special Week back in the 
day, man, talk about nostalgic. I was 
actually thinking I hadn't seen them 
around lately, but..."

text_block_list.name: Spectator with a Hat
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, what are you saying?! She's trending 
right now! Wait, you're in the same 
generation as Spe-chan?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator with a Hat
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. I thought she was just funny, but 
she's surprisingly amazing!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you hear? It seems an 
international guest will be running in 
this Yasuda Kinen too.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Well, no matter who my opponent is, it 
doesn't matter to me.
choice_data_list: All that's left is for you to win.
All you have to do is win.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Exactly! Obstacles have no place 
on my path.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna blow every last one of them away 
with these legs of mine!!
